responsibility: This is the hand-written parser for GNU C and Objective-C syntax in the C front end. It initializes reserved words, maintains lookahead token state, parses translation units, declarations, statements, expressions, and extensions such as transactional memory, tracks incomplete record declarations for end-of-file checks, and also hosts entry points for special embedded bodies such as __RTL and GIMPLE forms that are handed off to lower-level parsers or backend pass runners.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contains the full parser implementation and parser state for C/Objective-C syntax, including translation-unit parsing and handoff entry points for embedded __RTL and GIMPLE bodies; gcc/c/c-parser.h only exposes token definitions, enums, inline queries, and parser function declarations for clients of that parser.
